data.completion_memo: Implemented the bounded authenticated bootstrap gateway: OS-entropy one-use challenges, same-user peer and executable identity binding, canonical baton/admission hashes, capability revalidation, current/candidate/rollback generation fences, durable command admission and restart-rebuilt deduplication, fixed enrollment preparation, and recipient-exact result reads. Ten protocol scenarios plus workspace QA pass.
data.description: Implement the helper's sole core-facing versioned local protocol with one-use challenges, OS peer and executable identity, bounded DTOs, command deduplication, capability-report digest, accepted-baton hash, and current/candidate/rollback ProcessGeneration fences. Journal bytes before acknowledgement and reject stale, replayed, changed, or illegal-phase commands.
